coordinator_message: Coordinator: Keep mechanical migration strictly idempotent and error-guided. Broad regex over whole mixed production/test files must not alter production declarations/calls or already-updated calls. Only insert missing run_attempt field/argument at actual compiler error spans; preserve all prior fixture data, assertions and arbitrary inputs. Avoid non-idempotent repeated append of 1 or greedy patterns that consume unrelated calls. Root will inspect full diff and run merged tests. No production behavior edits.
